title: Extra Life
blurb: Three ascending notes, half a second, pure reward. The 1-up jingle is one of the great pieces of 8-bit design — short enough not to interrupt play, distinctive enough that you hear it over everything else, and pitched so that your brain reads it as gain before you have identified what happened. Use it when somebody gets a second chance they arguably did not earn: a resit, a rematch, a relationship. Streamers wire it to donation alerts and editors save it for comeback moments. Original synthesis, free to use anywhere.
origin: Original 1-up style jingle synthesis in the 8-bit tradition.
